### New

* **Cleaner messages on newer Kindles.** On firmware 5.16.3 and later (e.g. the Kindle 11th gen), status messages now appear in a bordered box in the middle of the screen, in the Kindle's own font (Amazon Ember). Finished messages go away by themselves after a few seconds; "in progress" ones stay until the next message. Older firmware keeps the one-line message at the bottom.
* **Finds FBInk on newer Kindles.** The FBInk that comes with the current jailbreak tools (`/var/local/kmc/kindlehf`) and CoverSleep's `fbink_hf` are now used, so the Kindle's plain built-in text display is no longer the fallback there.

### Upgrading from v1.1.0

Unzip `calibre-wireless-1.2.0.zip` onto the Kindle's root, replacing the old files. Your settings in `extensions/calibre-wireless/config.sh` are kept.
